title: Modeling Large-Scale Adversarial Swarm Engagements using Optimal Control
summary: We study optimal control of large-scale autonomous systems under adversarial conditions in which agents may be probabilistically destroyed during an engagement. Because attrition changes the population that generates the spatial interaction dynamics, treating survival and motion independently can produce physically inconsistent solutions. We formulate a stochastic variable-population benchmark and examine three deterministic approximations that propagate agent survival probabilities from relative geometry.
